field.label: Custom TTL
field.help: TTL returned for answers coming from the entries on the Host Overrides tab.

field.label: Filter unmapped types
field.help: For a mapped name, return an empty answer for record types you have not provided (e.g. no AAAA when only an IPv4 address is mapped) instead of forwarding the query upstream.

field.label: Zone file
field.help: Optional DNS zone-file content for advanced records (e.g. CNAME), in standard zone format, e.g. printer.lan. IN A 192.168.1.20. Names end with a dot unless an $ORIGIN line comes before them, and every record needs a TTL, the class IN or a $TTL line before it. Blocky answers A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, SRV, HTTPS and SVCB records; other types, such as SOA or MX, may be present but are not answered. HTTPS and SVCB records are answered as written, except that ipv6hint is left out while AAAA is a dropped query type; e.g. app.lan. 3600 IN A 192.168.1.10 with app.lan. 3600 IN HTTPS 1 . alpn="h3,h2" announces HTTP/3 for app.lan. Combined with the simple entries on the Host Overrides tab, but a name in the zone is answered from the zone alone, so its addresses belong in the zone too.
